core_obligations: Construct the resolutions (proof lines 3195-3200): for each n the author resolves the truncation tau_{<= n}G^bullet by a bounded above complex K_n^bullet whose terms are direct sums of modules of the form j_{U!}O_U, with the vertical maps quasi-isomorphic and termwise surjective.

Arrange the compatibility (proof lines 3200-3204): the construction is made compatible with the transition maps so that the maps K_n^bullet -> K_{n+1}^bullet are termwise split injections with cokernels of the stated shape, and the colimit of the K_n^bullet quasi-isomorphic to G^bullet.
proof_roadmap: Resolve each truncation by direct sums of extensions by zero.
Arrange the resolutions compatibly so that the transition maps are split injections with the stated cokernels.
Check that the colimit maps quasi-isomorphically to the original complex.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces, for any complex of modules on a ringed site, a commutative diagram of resolutions of its truncations by bounded above complexes whose terms are direct sums of extensions by zero of structure sheaves, with termwise surjective quasi-isomorphisms, termwise split transition maps and the stated cokernels, and with the colimit quasi-isomorphic to the original complex (statement lines 3172-3193, with the Xy-pic diagram delivered verbatim). The proof constructs the resolutions with the stated properties (proof lines 3195-3200) and arranges their compatibility, including the colimit statement (proof lines 3200-3204). The non-formal content is the compatibility of the constructions over n. The claim is H2: one recursive construction plus one compatibility check.
